## Checklist

- [ ] Branch name follows `feature/`, `fix/`, or `docs/` convention
- [ ] Commit messages follow Conventional Commits
- [ ] `npm run typecheck` passes
- [ ] `npm run lint` passes
- [ ] `npm run format:check` passes
- [ ] `npm test` passes, and new behavior is covered by tests
- [ ] Changes stay within the assigned feature folder (or shared-file changes are called out below)
- [ ] No secrets, tokens, keys, or `.env.local` files are included
- [ ] No new dependency added, or the dependency was approved in the issue
- [ ] Documentation updated if behavior, setup, or conventions changed
